infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Add tasks you create from the calendar to Apple Calendar.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Sync your daily tasks with Apple Reminders.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Read your steps, walking distance, activity, sleep, and weight to show progress on the Body and Today screens.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: This app does not write health data; permission is only requested for compatibility with HealthKit.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connect to your Companion HUD device to relay voice commands to the AI.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Transcribe voice questions from your Companion HUD device (unused — cloud transcription is used instead).
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keep tracking your hike, run, or walk in the background if you lock your phone or switch apps mid-activity.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Track your route, distance, and pace while recording a hike, run, or walk.
